examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: For a continuous uniform variable on [a,b], probability is interval-length ratio, mean is (a+b)/2, and variance is (b−a)²/12. Split an expectation integral wherever the random outcome changes formula. Selecting a random point does not select differently sized resulting intervals with equal probability.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
X is uniform on [2,8]. Find Var(X).

**Answer: 3.** The interval width is 6. Uniform variance is width²/12=36/12=3. Shifting an interval changes its mean but not the variance for a fixed width.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
For a finite discrete uniform distribution, use sums or the discrete formula; the continuous variance formula cannot be reused unchanged.

For a continuous uniform variable, including or excluding an interval endpoint does not change its probability.
